title: Routing evaluation record
description: One line of evals/routing.jsonl. Checks that retrieval ranks the right cards and reports execution readiness honestly. It does not judge the final answer; see golden-question.schema.json.

expected_cards.description: All listed cards must rank at or above max_rank; this is not an alternatives list.

max_rank.description: Worst allowed rank for every expected card. The validator also requires len(expected_cards) <= max_rank <= cutoff.

required_interfaces.description: For executable-if-available, these interfaces collectively bridge every expected metric and each interface bridges at least one.

cutoff.description: Retrieval cutoff the runtime actually uses. Reproduce ranking failures at this cutoff, never at a tool default.

layer.description: volatile records depend on live data or a moving report and may be quarantined without blocking a release.
